description.value: A 24-acre informal show garden near Courtenay featuring over 3,000 rhododendrons, bark mulch paths winding through natural forest, and numerous water features. Recognized as one of the world's finest informal show gardens and a Canada 150 Garden Experience, the gardens were hand-built by one man over decades. Located 15 minutes north of Courtenay just off the Old Island Highway, it also hosts annual art festivals and summer concerts.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active 24-acre woodland garden near Courtenay on Vancouver Island, open year-round, with events scheduled through August 2026 and copyright dated 2005-2026. Phone (250-338-6901) and address (6183 Whitaker Road, Courtenay) match between OSM and the website contact page. The visitor amenities page lists resting benches, gazebo, picnic area, and tea room, but makes no mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms. The tea room qualifies as food on site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, year-round attraction on Vancouver Island with confirmed 2026 activity. A touring cyclist passing through the Comox Valley would enjoy a restful stop here, though bike-specific amenities could not be confirmed from available evidence.

Café or food on site.detail: Tea room listed as a visitor amenity on the visitors page

wow_evidence: 24-acre hand-built woodland garden of 3,000+ rhododendrons, Canada 150 Garden Experience; spectacular in spring bloom.
blurb: Woodland garden of three thousand rhododendrons north of Courtenay.
